_README: Canary plaintext strings that must NOT appear verbatim in shipped client bundles (dist/). These are sensitive brand / domain / proxy-software strings the client-side protection is supposed to hide. This list lives in scripts/ so it is NEVER itself emitted into the bundle. Keep it SMALL and documented: add a string only when it is a real literal currently rendered to users that we commit to hiding. Scanned by scripts/check-plaintext-leaks.mjs (exit 2 on any hit — hard fail, no opt-out).

canaries.reason: B1: brand name (index.html metas, sign-in copy, footer, document.title).
B1: brand lowercase (storage keys fracital:*, favicon, URLs).
B1: direct-host domain.
B1: author handle (index.html meta description).
B1: GitHub org in repo URL (footer/about links).
P1: proxy engine name (vendored runtime, globals, paths). Renamed by the proxy transform.
P1: proxy engine name, PascalCase (classes, labels).

P1: wisp client library name. NOTE: bare 'wisp'/'Wisp' is deliberately NOT a canary (same as abulxt): the bundled wisp client declares identifiers (class names, this.wisp_url) in positions that cannot be veiled. The relay is protected by the gate-keyed opaque path instead.
P1: relay path fingerprint on the wire.
P1: transport mux name (hyphen form).

P1: transport engine name (epoxy-tls); wasm export names renamed too.
